d:
Hamara sanvidhan keval ek dastavez nahin, balki bharat ki loktantrik chetna, hamare adhikaron aur kartavyon ka aadhar hai. yahi hamen vividhtaon ke bich ekta, samanta aur nyay ke sutr men pirota hai.
Aaie, sanvidhan divas ke avsar par bhartiy sanvidhan ke mulyon ko aatmasat karne aur ek sashakt, samaveshi evan nyaypurn bharat ke nirman ka sankalp len.
Sanvidhan hamara gaurav, loktantr hamari pahchan!
Didi jharkhand ki or se aap sabhi ko sanvidhan divas ki hardik shubhkamnaen.
